proposed_comments.title: Resolve the app-wide selection chord before the source-button guard
proposed_comments.body:
### Resolve the app-wide selection chord before the source-button guard

**Severity:** `high`

The current handler returns before checking the selection shortcut unless `OriginalSource` is already inside a shelf button. Access keys are app-wide, so Alt+Shift+digit from another focused control never reaches the new selection path. Please split the visibility check from the source-button lookup, resolve and reserve the selection chord immediately after confirming the shelf is visible, and only then require a shelf-button source for Ctrl+Enter, Ctrl+K, and item-context shortcuts.

confidence.rationale: The early combined guard is directly visible immediately above the added shortcut block, and it excludes every event whose source is outside a shelf button despite the app-wide access-key contract.
